newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba's Issing prefers money supply as ECB goal.
newsitem.headline: Buba's Issing prefers money supply as ECB goal.

text.p: Bundesbank chief economist Otmar Issing said in a newspaper article published on Saturday that the future European Central Bank should use money supply as an "interim target" in the quest for price stability.
In an article written for the German Boersen Zeitung, he added that employing a money supply-based goal was more suitable than direct inflation-based targets.
A money supply target, such as that used by the Bundesbank itself, could however over time be complemented by measures seeking directly to influence inflation, he said.
Issing said that the planned central bank should also seek to reinforce its credibility by making its main decision-making criteria open and comprehensible to the outside world.
